title: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate
function: Mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this electrochemical application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining from plate for electrochemical geometry
TIG welding all-position with 0.5mm corner radius
Passivation DI rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for mixed metal oxide application
commonFailures: Weld zone preferential attack in chlorinated water - controlled by post-weld pickling and proper filler selection — critical for mixed metal oxide performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate suitable for Mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate?
faq.a: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address electrochemical operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for mixed metal oxide requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. mixed metal oxide components require Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for mixed metal oxide application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet mixed metal oxide specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for MMO substrate / Coated plate electrochemical components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
